units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 16:1">Pesik. R. s. 16</cite> (expl. <cite ref="T00889"><he>רעי</he></cite>, <cite ref="I Kings 5:3">I Kings V, 3</cite>) <he>מן המרעה</he> from the pasture ground; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 176:2">Yalk. Kings 176</cite>.

Sabb. XX, 4 גורפין מלפני הפטם … מפני הר׳ (Y. ed. הריעי) you may (on the Sabbath) sweep the crib before the stall-ox, and move (the remnants) aside for the sake of the grazing animal (which is ordinarily fed on the pasture); Y. ib. 17ᶜ bot. מפני (ש)מה שהפטם מותיר הר׳ אוכל because the grazing animal eats what the stall-ox leaves over.—[Comment. erroneously: מפני הר׳ on account of soiled matter, v. next w.]
